newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African average T-Bill rate 14.99 percent.
newsitem.headline: S.African average T-Bill rate 14.99 percent.

text.p: The average discount rate for South African three-month Treasury Bills rose to 14.99 percent at the latest weekly tender after dipping to 14.93 percent last week, the Reserve Bank said.
Applications for the 700 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.190 billion rand. The average price was 96.265 rand percent.

The average rate for six-month bills was 15.07 percent from 15.11 percent. Applications for the 200 million rand of bills on offer totalled 1.197 billion rand. The average price was 92.485 rand percent.
